nonblocking_limits: The fixture is deliberately pytest-scoped; running the restored protected module directly with unittest.main bypasses conftest. The supported mandatory test runner is pytest.

Exceptional cleanup routines can replace an earlier exception if cleanup itself raises, retaining its Python exception context; this matches normal context-manager cleanup behavior and does not weaken any existing semantic assertion.
No new joined-request-worker behavior is introduced. Original six tests retain their completion/event assertions before teardown; functional validation must exercise them.
approval_condition: Restore the two protected files exactly, apply only these reviewed prepared live bytes and verified archival files, then run all mandatory gates. Approval is not a passing regression result or publication authorization.
